title: 9 Keys to Marketing Your Health Club, Fitness Studio, or Gym

facts.fact: The page was posted on January 18, 2018.
The author uses a three-month pre-sale period as the example length for a health club pre-sale promotion.
facts.quote: If your pre-sale is going to last for three months, your best offer should be at the start of the pre-sale

facts.fact: The author recommends changing the pre-sale offer on a bi-weekly or monthly basis so the club can tell prospects the price is going up.
facts.quote: change on a bi-weekly or monthly basis so that you can always say, “join now because the price is going up
